memories.author: D05
memories.text: Vitamin B12 deficiency and Vitamin D deficiency. Patient, a 28‑year‑old female postal worker, reports fatigue, occasional tingling in feet, and low mood. On examination she appears pale, no lymphadenopathy, lungs clear. Spirometry not indicated. Labs ordered.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
methylcobalamin 1500 mcg OD
cholecalciferol 60000 IU once weekly for 8 weeks

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
Serum vitamin B12: 180 pg/mL (ref 200‑900)
MCV: 98 fL (ref 80‑100)
Haemoglobin: 11.8 g/dL (ref 12‑16)
Serum 25‑hydroxyvitamin D: 12 ng/mL (ref 30‑100)
Serum calcium: 9.1 mg/dL (ref 8.5‑10.5)
Serum phosphate: 2.8 mg/dL (ref 2.5‑4.5)

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Vitamin B12 deficiency improving, Vitamin D still low. Patient reports less fatigue, no tingling. Exam: mild pallor, lungs clear. Spirometry performed: FEV1 2.85 L (92% pred), FVC 3.40 L (95% pred), FEV1/FVC 0.84. Change in FEV1 since baseline +0.15 L. Asthma Control Test not applicable. Technique checked: correct. Vit D replacement to be switched to maintenance.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
methylcobalamin 1500 mcg OD
cholecalciferol 1000 IU OD

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Vitamin B12 now within normal range, haemoglobin improved. Vitamin D still suboptimal. Patient feels well, occasional mild breathlessness on exertion. Exam: lungs clear, no wheeze. Spirometry: FEV1 2.90 L (94% pred), FVC 3.42 L (96% pred), FEV1/FVC 0.85, change +0.20 L from first visit. Technique checked: correct. Continue current doses.

memories.author: front_desk
memories.text: Follow‑up appointment booked for 2025-10-05 at 10:00 AM with Dr Suresh Menon (D05).

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Vitamin B12 stable, Vitamin D approaching target. Patient reports good energy, no neuro symptoms. Exam: normal vitals, lungs clear. Spirometry: FEV1 2.92 L (95% pred), FVC 3.44 L (97% pred), FEV1/FVC 0.85, change +0.22 L from baseline. Technique checked: correct. Plan to maintain B12, continue Vitamin D maintenance.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Both vitamin B12 and Vitamin D now within normal ranges. Patient asymptomatic, works full shifts without fatigue. Exam: pink conjunctiva, lungs clear. Spirometry: FEV1 2.95 L (96% pred), FVC 3.46 L (98% pred), FEV1/FVC 0.85, change +0.25 L from first visit. Technique checked: correct. Consider tapering B12 after 3 months of stability.

memories.author: patient
memories.text: Via clinic app: 'Hi Doctor, I’ve been feeling a bit more tired over the past week and have occasional mild shortness of breath when climbing stairs. My B12 tablets are fine. Should I come in?'

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Spirometry performed today: FEV1 2.88 L (93% pred), FVC 3.38 L (95% pred), FEV1/FVC 0.85. Change in FEV1 since last visit (2026-01-10) –0.07 L. Technique checked: correct. No significant bronchodilator response. Interpretation: mild restrictive pattern possibly related to recent mild anemia; lungs otherwise clear.
